LanguageData.AUT.MaximumDeathTimeTT: The maximum amount of time before it becomes impossible to extract anything usable from a corpse.
LanguageData.AUT.ConsumeInputOnNormalTT: If enabled, the corpse is consumed. If disabled, the corpse will remain without its organs.
LanguageData.AUT.AllowRepeatUntilDepleted: Allow multiple autopsies on the same corpse
LanguageData.AUT.AllowRepeatUntilDepletedTT: If enabled, the same corpse can be processed repeatedly while it still has valid organs to harvest.
